case.title: MSC ELSA 3 capsized and sank off Alappuzha, Kerala
case.subRegion: Arabian Sea, ~13 nm off Thottappally / ~40 nm SSW of Kochi

oil.spilledNote: Quantity released not published. Oil sheen observed near wreck (diesel leakage per SITREP-4).

vessels.name: MSC ELSA 3

anchors.source: SITREP-3 ('about 30 nm SW of Kochi'); position approximate

vessels.note: Deployed from Cochin to assist

vessels.note: Remained on standby, coordination support

observations.description: Aerial surveillance: signs of oil spill in vicinity of wreck (ICG Dornier)
30 containers landed along 120 km coast (Kollam 29, Alappuzha 1)

timeline.event: Starboard list reported en route Vizhinjam to Kochi
List increased to 30 degrees and stabilised
Coordination meeting: DGS, MMD Kochi, ICG, Navy, Kochi Port, MSC (2000 IST)
Vessel sank; all deck containers adrift incl. 13 IMDG Class 4.3 (calcium carbide)
Follow-up coordination meeting (1100 IST); T&T Salvage appointed
30 containers ashore along 120 km; oil sheen near site; wreck at ~60 m depth

response: Indian Coast Guard (Dornier, ICGS Arnvesh, ICGS Saksham)
case.officialFindings: Flooding in one compartment led to capsize. Fort Kochi Coastal Police registered a case against the master and crew.

legal.note: Criminal case registered for navigation errors and environmental negligence

assumptions: Extent not reported; 1 km radius marker around reported location

sarMeasurements.method: Adaptive-threshold dark-spot detection on Lee-filtered, noise-corrected sigma0 (classical method, not a trained model)
limitations: Dark spots include look-alikes (low wind, biogenic films, rain cells); the look-alike checks must still be applied
Land is masked with a coastline plus a coastal buffer; detections within a few km of shore remain unreliable
Multilooking trades resolution for speckle reduction; slicks narrower than two output pixels can be missed
The quicklook is in radar geometry (not north-up); use the outlines on the map for location
